questions.q: What does William James describe as the "habitual center of personal energy"?
a: The dominant set of beliefs guiding life
questions.why: He links it to the dominant belief system.

questions.q: How does James suggest prayer affects a person?
a: Transfers higher‑power energy into the soul
questions.why: He defines prayer as energy transfer from a higher power.

questions.q: What is the broader meaning of "conversion" in James's view?
a: A shift of energy from one belief set to another
questions.why: Conversion means changing the direction of personal energy.

questions.q: Which earlier works does James compare belief's power to?
a: Think and Grow Rich and The Magic of Thinking Big
questions.why: He cites those self‑help books as similar ideas.

questions.q: What outcome does James claim can result from religious‑like experiences?
questions.why: He links religious experience to relief from depression.
